_meta.method: Every assignment is grounded in the donor (luckydreamer_3.html), in HANDOFF priority order: (a) the donor's own live voicing of the same cell or figure; (b) the donor's ensemble/timeline voice tables and drums-module commentary; (c) the physics table (PERC_RECIPE) where a name is unambiguous, with reasoning recorded. The donor's FIG catalog itself is data-only (figHits has zero callers) — the ground truth is the LIVE engine: KPAT/KPAT12 cells, KSTYLES perc rows, C12_ENS voice tables, and the TIMELINE_16 plan voices.

keyEvidence.batucadaRows: donor L11841-11853: kick pat 'surdo1' on the 46 Hz batucadaK kick; perc ['surdo', surdo2-cells]; ['congaL', surdo3-cells]; ['woodblk', telecoteco-cells]; ['agogoH', bell line]; aux ['shaker', 32 steps] (ganzá), ['guiro'], ['timbH']
keyEvidence.kpat: donor L11462-11465: surdo1 'marcação: beat two', surdo2 'the answer', surdo3 'the cutter', telecoteco
keyEvidence.ensembles: donor L12312-12348 C12_ENS voices — dunumba/soli: hi agogoH, lo agogoL; tiriba/sorsonet: lo woodblk; bembeCu (Cuban): hi cowbell (guataca), lo agogoL, deep congaL, hold congaH; kple: hi agogoH, lo cowbell, deep congaM, hold bongoH. Bells voice on hi, low-tone strokes/bell2 on lo (cycGens L12407-12408).
keyEvidence.planVoices: donor L16680-16686: congaM ← TIMELINE_16.tumbaoC ('two slaps then two open tones', L7190), congaH ← tumbaoC rotated, cowbell ← TIMELINE_16.cascara, bongoH ← cascara rotated 3, woodblk ← TIMELINE_16.tamborim (L7191), agogoH ← TIMELINE_16.agogo, surdo ← beat-3 accent
keyEvidence.bigFour: donor L19275-19276: gens kick.bigFour pushes slot 11 (crash) beside the bass drum
keyEvidence.pressRoll: donor L19300-19303: pressP re-plays 3 grace hits crushed in before the backbeat on the snare slot
keyEvidence.strokeTokens: donor interprets stroke letters only on djembe lanes — 'B'→djembeB, 'S'→djembeS, else djembeT (L19373, L19391-19396): stroke→slot is the donor's own articulation idiom

schema.inst: PERC_RECIPE instrument that voices every hit (default route)
schema.lane: TRITON kit lane 0-11 (note 48+lane) for kit-native figures — kick/snare/crash have no PERC_RECIPE entry, matching the donor, which voices these on its kit lanes too
schema.tones: figures with a tone row: instrument per tone letter {L, H}
schema.strokes: per stroke-token override; fields: inst (reroute to another recipe), lane (reroute to kit lane), mute (multiply decay), roll (expand into N crushed grace hits before the beat), pitch (multiply fundamental)
schema.pitch: fundamental multiplier applied to the recipe's hz for the whole figure
schema.altPitch: cycle of pitch multipliers applied hit-by-hit (the cuíca's two-voice talk)
schema.cls: evidence class — A: donor voices this exact cell/figure; B: donor voice tables/commentary; C: physics-table semantics, reasoned and recorded

bembe.ev: Tone row split hi/lo exactly as the donor voices bells (cycGens L12407-12408). Default = the Ewe/Guinean ensembles' agogoH/agogoL pair (dunumba, soli — L12316, L12328); the Cuban bembeCu alternate is hi=cowbell (guataca) lo=agogoL (L12342).

ashanti.ev: The dunumba ensemble's bell IS 'ashanti' (L12313), voiced on voices.hi='agogoH' (L12316, L12407).

bemba7.ev: Axe-blade iron bell in the ashanti rotation family; ensemble hi-bell voice (L12316).

bondo.ev: Aka metal-strip bell; ensemble hi-bell voice (L12316).

tambu.ev: The heru is an iron hoe/plough metallophone — the donor's guataca (hoe blade) voice is cowbell (bembeCu hi, L12342).

yoruba.ev: Konkonkolo/Omele bell of Yoruba sacred music; ensemble hi-bell voice. Its Cuban palitos usage lives in guaguaColumbia below.

bembe2.ev: bembeCu bell2='bembe2' voiced on voices.lo='agogoL' (L12340-12342, L12408); tone row is all L.

asaadua.ev: Dawuro (atoke) iron bell of the Akan; ensemble hi-bell voice.

soli.ev: The soli ensemble's bell IS 'soli' (L12325), voiced on voices.hi='agogoH' (L12328).

sorsonet.ev: The sorsonet ensemble's bell IS 'sorsonet' (L12331), voiced on voices.hi='agogoH' (L12334).

kitaab.ev: Safī al-Dīn's rhythm books specify the cycle, not an instrument; kept on the ensemble hi bell for family coherence with soli (its rotation kin).

venda.ev: A clapping pattern (L12182); the roster has no clap — claves are the concussion-stick analog (wood, 1250 Hz, hard transient). Donor never voices venda (absent from C12_ENS and BELLS_12).

columbia.ev: Cuban columbia/Abakuá bell — the donor's Cuban 12/8 bell voice is cowbell (bembeCu hi, L12342).

bemba5.ev: Zimbabwe bell pattern; ensemble hi-bell voice.

fumeFume.ev: The kple ensemble's bell IS 'fumeFume' (L12344), voiced on voices.hi='agogoH' (L12347).

salve.ev: Bell-role timeline (Dominican salve / Tuareg / Al Kudám); ensemble hi-bell default.

adenkum.ev: Dawuro bell of the Akan; ensemble hi-bell voice.

cuban8.ev: Ortiz's Cuban ternary bell — Cuban bell voice = cowbell (bembeCu hi, L12342).

clave68.ev: Named and played as the 6/8 clave; claves recipe (wood 1250 Hz). The bembé-bell reading of the same cell lives in fumeFume, which the donor keeps separate.

claveColumbia.ev: The triple-pulse rumba clave — the clave instrument plays clave patterns; recipe clave (wood 1250 Hz).

guaguaColumbia.ev: Palitos on the guagua/catá — palitos→woodblock (HANDOFF §4c); the donor rides its struck-stick 16-grid timelines on woodblk (L16686).

marchTwoBeat.ev: New Orleans march bass drum — the donor voices bass-drum cells on the kit kick lane (lineKick school, L11448, L11787); no PERC_RECIPE has a bass drum.

habanera.ev: The contradanza cell as a struck timeline; the donor voices such 16-grid cells on woodblk (L16686). Its bass-drum half is bigFour's territory.

bigFour.ev: Donor L19275-19276: the Big Four lands bass drum AND crash — gens kick.bigFour pushes slot 11 ('crash', KIT_SLOTS L4430). 'B' strokes stay on the kick lane.

pressRoll.ev: Donor's press-roll mechanism: 3 grace hits crushed in before the accent on the snare slot (L19300-19303); 'R' strokes expand to the crush, 'A' accents strike clean.

gogoConga.ev: The gogo style's congas: congaM carries the answers, congaH the high accents (L11765-11770); the lone slap 'S' takes the higher, harder-slap drum.

cavacha.ev: 'Played on snare or hi-hat with ghosted sixteenths' (FIG from-field); the donor voices ghosted-sixteenth lanes on the kit snare (caixa mechanism, L19181-19186).

claveBossa.ev: The bossa snare-RIM figure — a rim click's dry knock is the woodblock's register, and the donor rides its 16-grid stick timelines on woodblk (L16686). The TRITON kit has no rim lane.

telecoteco.ev: Byte-identical cell voiced on 'woodblk' in batucada (L11846 = KPAT.telecoteco L11465); woodblk is the donor's tamborim stand-in (L7191→L16686).

telecotecoUp.ev: The up side of the same tamborim cell — same voice (L11846, L16686).

partidoAlto.ev: The donor's samba branch draws 'partido' from TIMELINE_16 and voices it on woodblk (L16404, L16686).

palitoGuaguanco.ev: Palitos struck on the guagua — palitos→woodblock (HANDOFF §4c); parent figure of cascara23.

quintoLock.ev: The quinto is the highest conga → congaH open tones (190/260/340 roster). Slap strokes take the roster's one true slap recipe (djembeS: hz 380 ≈ congaH 340, slapLvl 0.62, hard 0.9) — stroke→slot is the donor's own articulation idiom (djembe B/T/S, L19373). The donor has no guaguancó style to overrule this.

quintoColumbia.ev: Triple-pulse quinto lock — same drum, same stroke idiom as quintoLock.

salidorGuaguanco.ev: The salidor is the low conga (physics table: congaL 190 Hz is the roster's low conga); 'B' bass strokes are muffled — decay shortened, pitch kept.

marchaConga.ev: The donor's one-drum conga voice: congaM carries tumbaoC — 'two slaps then two open tones' on ONE drum (L7190, L16680). Heel/tip ghosts, slaps and opens all live on congaM as written.

tumbaoDos.ev: The tumba is the low drum of the two-drum tumbao — congaL by the physics table; the donor's pair rides congaM/congaH (L16680-16681) but the FIG is explicitly the tumba's part.

martillo.ev: Martillo→bongos (HANDOFF §4c): macho strokes (mS/mT/mO/mB) on bongoH (620 Hz), the hembra open tone 'hO' on bongoL (430 Hz) — the stroke order the FIG's sources fix.

campanaSon.ev: The campana IS the bongó bell → cowbell (540 Hz wood-body bell recipe). 'M' mouth strokes open; 'n' neck strokes damped (halved decay).

campanaMambo.ev: The timbalero's mambo bell — same campana voice, same mouth/neck articulation.

cascara23.ev: The donor voices TIMELINE_16.cascara on PERC_IDX.cowbell (L16682; rotated echo on bongoH, L16683) — its own hand puts the shell figure on the bell metal, NOT on timbL/timbH.

abanico.ev: Timbale vocabulary on the timbale recipe (timbH 420 Hz, hard 0.88): 'O' rim shot clean, 'R' expands to a crush like the donor's press mechanism (L19300-19303), 'b' buzz strokes damped.

surdoPrimeira.ev: The donor's marcação: batucadaK's 46 Hz kick plays surdo1 (L11172, L11841) — 46/62 = 0.74 of the surdo recipe's fundamental. 'M' strokes are the muffled hand-on-head.

surdoSegunda.ev: The answer: the batucada 'surdo' perc row IS surdo2's cells verbatim (L11844 = KPAT.surdo2 L11463), on the 62 Hz surdo recipe.

surdoTerceira.ev: The cutter: the donor voices surdo3's cells verbatim on congaL (L11845 = KPAT.surdo3 L11464) — its own hand puts the third surdo a register up, on skin not boom.

caixa.ev: The caixa is the kit snare with wires always on: snare gens caixa flag (L11842) drives the kit snare slot (L19181-19186); batucadaK's snare is the wire-heavy voicing (wireLvl 0.85, L11174).

tamborimCarreteiro.ev: Woodblk is the donor's tamborim voice (TIMELINE_16.tamborim → PERC_IDX.woodblk, L7191, L16686). 'd' downstrokes and 'v' virada accents differ by written velocity.

ganza.ev: The batucada aux 32-step shaker row IS the ganzá role (L11848-11853); recipe shaker with the donor's rebound envelope.

cuica.ev: The cuíca is a friction drum that talks in two registers — the roster's bendable drum is 'talking' (PERC_SAG 1.0). The donor leaves the cuíca unvoiced (the teleco cell on woodblk is tamborim duty, L11846); hit-alternating pitch multipliers speak the hoo-hee.

maculele.ev: Grimas are paired hardwood sticks struck together — claves by another name (wood 1250 Hz, hard 0.98). Donor never voices maculelê.
